statements.subject: message
statements.description: Also, the corresponding ESEARCH response MUST include the UID indicator.
actions: include UID indicator in ESEARCH response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: However, server implementations MUST implicitly include the UID message data item as part of any FETCH response caused by a UID command, regardless of whether a UID was specified as a message data item to the FETCH.
statements.trigger: UID command causes untagged FETCH response
actions: implicitly include UID message data item in every FETCH response generated by a UID command
